description: This file defines an interface IErrorGrain with task-based asynchronous methods related to error handling and operations within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IErrorGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that provides various methods for error handling, logging, delays, and child grain management in Orleans.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets a value representing an error A.

methods.name: SetBError
methods.description: Sets a value representing an error B.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves a computed error based on internal state.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Retrieves a computed error based on input parameters a and b.

methods.name: LongMethodWithError
methods.description: Performs a long-wait operation with potential error handling.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Delays for the specified number of milliseconds asynchronously.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Simulates an unobserved error with continuation.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Simulates another continuation for unobserved error.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Simulates an unobserved ignored error scenario.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds a list of child grains.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes an action after a delay asynchronously.
